from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
import hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, zipfile

r = Path('/Users/agrudin/dev/my/ariadna')
p = Path('/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0293')
base = '5c746e459c0f2029c5cfc13689fac72017091c86'
changed = {'CURRENT_STATE.md', 'docs/adr/README.md', 'openspec/ROADMAP.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/design.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/tasks.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/specs/research-trajectory-experiment/spec.md'}
new = {'docs/adr/0293-full-owner-binding-design.md',
       'docs/adr/experiments/0293-full-owner-binding-design.json',
       'docs/adr/experiments/0293-full-owner-binding-design-evidence.zip'}
proof = 'docs/adr/experiments/0293-doc-verification.json'
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=r, text=True).strip()
def pin(raw): return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == base and git('branch', '--show-current') == 'dev'
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
assert set(git('diff', '--name-only').splitlines()) == changed
assert set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()) == new
protected = 0
for row in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-rz', '--full-tree', base], cwd=r).split(b'\0'):
    if not row: continue
    metadata, name = row.split(b'\t', 1); name = name.decode()
    if name in changed: continue
    raw = (r / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest() == metadata.decode().split()[2], name
    protected += 1
x = json.loads((r / 'docs/adr/experiments/0293-full-owner-binding-design.json').read_bytes())
a = r / 'docs/adr/experiments' / x['archive']['name']
assert pin(a.read_bytes()) == {k: x['archive'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
with zipfile.ZipFile(a) as z:
    assert len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())) == x['archive']['members'] == 42 and z.testzip() is None
    assert all(not Path(n).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(n).parts for n in z.namelist())
    expanded = sum(i.file_size for i in z.infolist()); assert expanded == x['archive']['expanded_bytes'] == 531773 < 2097152
    d = {n: json.loads(z.read(n)) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.json')}
    scope, review, closure = (d[n] for n in ('scope.json', 'reviewer.json', 'source-closure.json'))
    assert scope['stage'] == 'F18.23' and scope['base_revision'] == base and scope['scientific_free_variables'] == []
    assert review['status'] == 'PASS' and not review['findings'] and len(review['resolved_initial_findings']) == 4
    assert closure == x['closure'] and closure['source_phase_passed'] is True and closure['new_native_authority'] is False
    assert closure['elapsed_after_source_fsync_s'] == 552.1201403327286 < 600 and closure['evidence_bytes_before_receipt'] == 528904 and closure['log_bytes'] == 0
    actual = d['source-actual-tool-return.json']; observed = json.loads(actual['output'])
    assert actual == x['source_actual_tool_return'] and actual['exit_code'] == 0 and observed['closure'] == closure
    assert observed['observed_after_closure_fsync_s'] == 552.1203474998474 < 600
    assert closure['independent_review_pin'] == pin(z.read('reviewer.json'))
    for name, expected in closure['contract_pins'].items(): assert pin(z.read(name)) == expected == review['reviewed_files'][name], name
    assert d['contract-pins.json']['files'] == closure['contract_pins']
    for name, expected in d['input-pins.json']['files'].items(): assert pin(z.read(name)) == expected, name
    for name, expected in d['supplemental-input-pins.json']['files'].items(): assert pin(z.read(name)) == expected, name
    oldpins = d['retained-control-pins.json']; assert len(oldpins) == 15
    previous = r / 'docs/adr/experiments/0290-full-owner-control-mapping-evidence.zip'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(previous) as prior:
        assert z.read('retained-control-pins.json') == prior.read('retained-control-pins.json')
        for name, expected in oldpins.items():
            member = 'retained-0286/' + name
            assert pin(z.read(member)) == expected and z.read(member) == prior.read(member), member
    for name in ('_owner_endpoint_fixture.py', '_owner_endpoint_run.py', '_owner_endpoint_audit.py'):
        assert z.read('original-source/' + name) == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':src/space_nav/' + name], cwd=r)
    c = d['binding-contract.json']; mapping = d['field-bindings-admission.json']
    assert c['status'] == mapping['status'] == 'DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_ADMITTED'
    assert len(c['active_controls']) == len(set(c['active_controls'])) == 8 and len(c['control_changes']) == 5
    assert d['profile-template.json'] == mapping['profile_template'] and d['decision-template.json'] == mapping['decision_template']
    for n in ('profile-template.json', 'decision-template.json'):
        t = d[n]; assert t['status'] == 'NOT_ADMITTED' and t['execution_stage'] is None and t['explicit_user_authorization'] is None and t['native_namespace_created'] is False
    profile = d['profile-template.json']['payload']; oldprofile = json.loads(z.read('retained-0286/episode/profile.json'))
    assert set(profile) == (set(oldprofile) - {'probe_input'}) | {'fixture_input'}
    assert profile['fixture_input'] == {'schema':'ariadna-owner-fixture-input-v1','scope':'synthetic-owner-conformance-only'}
    for name, count in (('source_pins',53),('native_pins',10),('resource_pins',11),('ledger_pins',25),('history_member_pins',86)):
        assert profile[name] == oldprofile[name] and len(profile[name]) == count, name
    assert len(mapping['field_bindings']) == 20 and len(mapping['argv_bindings']) == 5
    assert c['new_native_authority'] is False and c['tests_or_scientific_work_in_this_design'] is False
    assert x['implementation_adopted'] is False and x['new_native_authority'] is False and x['tests_scientific_native_or_mount_executed'] is False
links = anchors = 0
for name in sorted(changed | {n for n in new if n.endswith('.md')}):
    for dest in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', (r / name).read_text()):
        dest = dest.strip('<>')
        if '://' in dest or dest.startswith(('mailto:', 'data:')): continue
        file, _, frag = dest.partition('#'); q = ((r / name).parent / unquote(file)).resolve() if file else r / name
        if not q.exists(): assert q == r / proof, (name, dest)
        links += 1
        if frag and q.suffix == '.md':
            titles = re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$', q.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = {re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', t.strip().lower().replace('`', '')).replace(' ', '-') for t in titles}
            assert unquote(frag) in slugs, (name, dest); anchors += 1
assert len((r / 'CURRENT_STATE.md').read_text().splitlines()) < 60
tasks = (r / 'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/tasks.md').read_text()
assert '- [x] F18.23 ' in tasks and '- [ ] F18.24 ' in tasks
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], cwd=r, check=True)
v = subprocess.run(['openspec', 'validate', 'refine-physical-trajectory', '--strict'], cwd=r, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert v.returncode == 0, v.stdout + v.stderr
out = {'schema':'ariadna.f18.binding-design-documentary-check.v1', 'status':'PASS', 'base_revision':base,
       'protected_prior_blobs':protected, 'local_links':links, 'anchors':anchors,
       'archive_members':x['archive']['members'], 'archive_expanded_bytes':expanded,
       'archive_compressed_bytes':a.stat().st_size, 'strict_openspec':{'exit_code':v.returncode,'stdout':v.stdout,'stderr':v.stderr},
       'checked_files':{n:pin((r / n).read_bytes()) for n in sorted(changed | new)},
       'unchanged_full_suite_repeated':False, 'new_scientific_native_work':False,
       'scope':'Bounded binding design and documentary accuracy only; no implementation or native admission'}
with (p / 'doc-checks-final.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True); f.write('\n'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k != 'checked_files'}))
